claim: For the real hexagonal plane \(X_\gamma=(\mathbb R^2,N_\gamma)\), \(N_\gamma(x,y)=\max\{|y|,\ |x|+(1-\gamma)|y|\}\), one has \(C_{\mathrm{Pt}}(X_\gamma)=2/(1+\gamma)\) for every \(0<\gamma<1/2\).
integrity: The proof is self-contained and symbolic. The access-limited comparison sources are not used as proof premises and are retained as explicit originality risks.
scientific_limitations: The equality is asserted only for 0<gamma<1/2. The 2010 fixed-hexagon article was available through a detailed preview rather than readable full text, and the 2015 reconsideration article was available through abstract and bibliographic material only.
title: Exact Ptolemy constant on the first nontrivial hexagonal regime
